Hi Samira — looping in with a quick pre-check. Thanks for the traces — two quick things I see right away:

1) The 401 looks like a key-mismatch: the request shows a header X-Redwood-Key: <redacted> that doesn’t match the trial API key format (missing prefix). Can you confirm you copied the key from the "Keys" tab and not from the dashboard sample?

2) If you’re using the SDK, ensure you’ve set REDWOOD_API_KEY in the environment (we’ve seen folks accidentally put it into config files and run a stale process).

I can run a remote check if you add me (karthik@acmeai.com) as a collaborator on the trial account, or we can do a short 15-minute shared terminal before the full session.

If Wed 11/10 10:30am ET works, I’ll prepare a one-page checklist and a curl command to validate the key in under a minute.

Thanks,

2) Expect: your trial account id and 200 OK. If you get 401, paste the exact header and timestamp — we’ll look up the logs.

See you Wednesday —
